description_en: Queries the configurations of website forwarding rules
description_zh: 查询网站业务转发规则的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-rules --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain example.com --cname kzmk7b8tt3510000.aliyunddos10140000 --query-domain-pattern exact --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-i7m27nf30000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter to a value, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website to query.

The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names that have website forwarding rules configured
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站域名。

域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The query match mode. Valid values:
fuzzy (default): fuzzy match.
exact: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
查询匹配模式。取值：
fuzzy（默认）：表示模糊查询。
exact：表示精确查询
parameters.name: query_domain_pattern

parameters.help_en: The page number when you use paging. Set the current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of forwarding rules per page when you use paging. Set the number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含转发规则的数量。取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of website forwarding rules
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的网站业务转发规则的总数量

WebRules.description_en: The configurations of website forwarding rules
WebRules.description_zh: 网站业务转发规则的配置

BlackList.description_en: The IP blacklist (for the domain name)

items.description_en:
The blacklisted IP address for the domain name.

This parameter is returned only if you have configured an IP blacklist (for the domain name). You can call [ConfigWebIpSet]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157469.html） to configure IP blacklists and whitelists for a website domain name
items.description_zh:
针对该域名的黑名单IP。

仅在您已经为该域名配置了IP黑名单（针对域名）时返回该结果。您可以调用[ConfigWebIpSet]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157469.html）为网站域名配置IP黑白名单

CcEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Frequency Control (HTTP flood mitigation) is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
CcEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启了频率控制防护（CC防护）。取值：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

CcRuleEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether custom Frequency Control (HTTP flood mitigation) rules are enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
CcRuleEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启了自定义频率控制防护（CC防护）。取值：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

CcTemplate.description_en:
The mode of Frequency Control (HTTP flood mitigation). Valid values:
default: Normal mode.
gf_under_attack: Emergency mode.
gf_sos_verify: strict mode.
gf_sos_enhance: Super strict mode
CcTemplate.description_zh:
频率控制防护（CC防护）的模式。取值：
default：表示正常模式。
gf_under_attack：表示攻击紧急模式。
gf_sos_verify：表示严格模式。
gf_sos_enhance：表示超级严格模式

CertExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration timestamp of the associated certificate.
This parameter is not currently in use
CertExpireTime.description_zh:
关联证书过期时间戳
暂不使用

CertRegion.description_en:
The certificate region. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland (default).
ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
CertRegion.description_zh:
证书区域。取值：
cn-hangzhou：中国大陆地区（默认）
ap-southeast-1：非中国大陆地区

Cname.description_en: The CNAME address assigned by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium to the domain name
Cname.description_zh: 网站域名对应的DDoS高防CNAME地址

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled

是否开启了HTTP 2.0协议支持。取值：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

Http2HttpsEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the HTTPS forced redirect feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled

是否开启了HTTPS强制跳转功能。取值：

false：表示未开启

Https2HttpEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the HTTP back-to-origin feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled

是否开启了HTTP回源功能。取值：

OcspEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) feature is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
OcspEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用了OCSP（Online Certificate Status Protocol）功能。取值：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

ProxyEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether website forwarding is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
ProxyEnabled.description_zh:
网站业务转发是否开启。取值：

true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

ProxyTypes.description_en: The forwarding protocol and port configurations

ProxyType.description_en:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:
http: HTTP.
https: HTTPS.
websocket: WebSocket.
websockets: WebSockets
ProxyType.description_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
http：表示HTTP协议。
https：表示HTTPS协议。
websocket：表示WebSocket协议。
websockets：表示WebSockets协议

PunishReason.description_en:
The reason why the domain name is penalized for a violation. Valid values:
1: The domain name does not have an Internet Content Provider (ICP) filing.
2: The business operated on the domain name does not comply with regulatory requirements.

If both reasons 1 and 2 apply, the value 2 is returned
PunishReason.description_zh:
域名受到违规处罚的原因。取值：
1：表示域名未履行ICP备案。
2：表示域名经营的业务不符合监管要求。

如果同时包含原因1和2，该参数返回2

PunishStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is penalized for a violation. Valid values:

true: The domain name is penalized. You can check the PunishReason parameter for the specific reason.
false: The domain name is not penalized
PunishStatus.description_zh:
域名是否受到违规处罚。取值：

true：表示已受到违规处罚。您可以通过PunishReason查看受到违规处罚的具体原因。
false：表示未受到违规处罚

RsType.description_en:
The type of the origin server address. Valid values:

0: the IP address of the origin server.
1: the domain name of the origin server. This is typically used when another proxy service (such as WAF) is deployed between the origin server and Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium. The value specifies the redirect address of the proxy service (such as the WAF CNAME address)
RsType.description_zh:
源站服务器地址的类型。取值：

0：表示源站服务器的IP地址。
1：表示源站服务器的域名地址。通常适用于源站和高防之间还部署有其他代理服务（例如WAF）的场景，具体指代理服务的跳转地址（例如WAF CNAME地址）

Ssl13Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Ssl13Enabled.description_zh:
是否开启了TLS 1.3协议支持。取值：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

SslCiphers.description_en:
The type of cipher suite. Valid values:

default: custom cipher suites.
all: all cipher suites, including strong and weak cipher suites.
strong: strong cipher suites
SslCiphers.description_zh:
加密套件的类型。取值：

default：表示自定义加密套件。
all：表示全部加密套件，包含强加密套件和弱加密套件。
strong：表示强加密套件

SslProtocols.description_en:
The supported TLS protocol version. Valid values:

tls1.0: TLS 1.0 and later.
tls1.1: TLS 1.1 and later.
tls1.2: TLS 1.2 and later
SslProtocols.description_zh:
支持的TLS协议版本。取值：

tls1.0：表示支持TLS 1.0及以上版本。
tls1.1：表示支持TLS 1.1及以上版本。
tls1.2：表示支持TLS 1.2及以上版本

Tls13CustomCiphers.description_en: The list of cipher suites used for TLS 1.3
Tls13CustomCiphers.description_zh: TLS1.3版本使用的加密套件列表

items.description_en: The cipher suite used for TLS 1.3

UserCertName.description_en: The name of the certificate uploaded to SSL Certificates Service
UserCertName.description_zh: 用户上传到证书中心的证书名称

WafProtectionEnable.description_en: Indicates whether WAF protection is enabled for the domain name. Valid values: true: Enabled. false: Disabled
WafProtectionEnable.description_zh: 是否启用域名的WAF防护。true:启用；false:关闭
WafProtectionEnable.title_en: 是否启用域名的WAF防护。true:启用；false:关闭
WafProtectionEnable.title_zh: 是否启用域名的WAF防护。true:启用；false:关闭

WhiteList.description_en: The IP whitelist (for the domain name)

items.description_en:
The whitelisted IP address for the domain name.

This parameter is returned only if you have configured an IP whitelist (for the domain name). You can call [ConfigWebIpSet]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157469.html） to configure IP blacklists and whitelists for a website domain name
items.description_zh:
针对该域名的白名单IP。

仅在您已经为该域名配置了IP白名单（针对域名）时返回该结果。您可以调用[ConfigWebIpSet]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157469.html）为网站域名配置IP黑白名单
